metadata.description: Personal plugins, skills, commands, and utilities for Cursor.

plugins.name: copy
plugins.description: Format and copy AI-assistant output to clipboard for Slack, Email, Google Chat, Google Docs, or Jira.

plugins.name: setup-pulse
plugins.description: Install claude-pulse statusline for real-time token usage monitoring.

plugins.name: x
plugins.description: Post and read tweets on X (Twitter) from an AI-agent workflow. /x:tweet drafts, previews, and posts (single, threads, replies). /x:read fetches a tweet by URL or ID into context.

plugins.name: skill-reviewer
plugins.description: Evaluate any skill's design quality against best practices (based on https://x.com/trq212/status/2033949937936085378). Scores 10 dimensions (29-point rubric), detects anti-patterns, and optionally applies safe fixes.

plugins.name: find-session
plugins.description: Search past Claude Code and Codex conversations by keyword and get the correct resume command.

plugins.name: gdoc-math
plugins.description: Convert Markdown with LaTeX math into a native Google Doc with real, editable equations (pandoc OMML + gws Drive). /gdoc-math takes a .md file, inline content, or the last math content in the conversation.

plugins.name: claude-reviewer
plugins.description: Review any project's .claude/ folder setup against best practices (based on https://x.com/akshay_pachaar/status/2035341800739877091). Scores 8 dimensions (24-point rubric) covering CLAUDE.md quality, permissions, rules, commands, skills, agents, git hygiene, and progressive disclosure.

plugins.name: coacher
plugins.description: Primes AI coding agents with a peer-collaborator frame using native hooks, rules, commands, or skills (based on Amanda Askell's prompting philosophy via https://x.com/itsolelehmann/status/2045578185950040390).

plugins.name: natbag
plugins.description: Ben Gurion Airport (TLV) live flight data, destination weather, and historical delay analysis. /natbag shows departures, arrivals, specific flights, status, destination weather, and accumulated on-time/delay history.
